scope: CareerLens agent plane (sessions, runs, scheduler, capability). CLI frame envelopes stay in runtime-jsonl-v1.methods.json.

rules: Identity comes from the capability, never from model arguments.
A capability is rejected when the run is terminal or the attempt differs.
Capabilities expire and are reissued per attempt.

run_events.meaning: Run persisted; no executor has taken it.
Scheduler claimed the run with a fencing token.
CLI answered run.start; execution may begin. Not success.
Streamed model text. Persisted, so it owns a durable seq.
One model turn produced its final text.
Tool intents were submitted; nothing executed yet.
One invocation has a definite result.
Approval barrier; the run releases its lease.
User decision recorded; approved runs are re-queued.
CLI finished the turn; still not an authoritative terminal state.
Business store validated and committed the outcome.
Lease loss, crash or stale generation; retryable.
Retries exhausted or a non-retryable failure.

runtime_health.rule: Heartbeats express liveness only; run, event, approval and task facts remain owned by the business database. /health/ready keeps its database/retrieval semantics.

pool_rules: A warm shell has no session, history or credentials.
reserve is atomic and only takes a warm shell.
A bound shell is never returned to the pool; it is terminated.
Lost shells fault and are replaced with jittered backoff.
CLI total process cap counts spawning, warm and bound shells.

write_tools.name: save_career_note
write_tools.rule: evidence_ids 只能是当前用户已存在的证据 id；否则拒绝执行。

write_tools.name: write_workspace_file
write_tools.rule: 仅允许在 AGENT_WORKSPACE_ROOT 下写 UTF-8 文本；同 invocation 同 digest 不重复写，详见 agent-file-broker-v1.json。

tool_ledger.rule: 批准不等于重复执行：同一 invocation_id 与 args_digest 只产生一个 artifact，重复调用返回原结果；digest 变化则 tool_ledger_conflict；无审批或审批不匹配时拒绝执行，不伪造成功。

approval_recovery.rule: CLI/daemon 重启后只恢复该 invocation；scheduler 校验 approval.status=approved 且 args_digest 一致，否则 fail 且不执行工具。
